{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently 0.5-1.5 units too high, showing immediate overshoot that corrects within 1-2 days",
    "True outcomes exhibit steady gradual decline of ~0.3-0.5 units per day over the first 10-15 days, then stabilize at a level 3-5 units below model forecasts",
    "Sentiment positive ( >0.33) correlates with model being 2-3 units too high, while negative sentiment brings forecasts closer to reality",
    "The gap between model and true outcomes widens from ~1-2 units initially to ~4-6 units by day 15-20, showing increasing lag",
    "Model fails to capture the downward momentum early on, forecasting prices that are 3-5 units higher than actual for the first week",
    "No significant difference between bullish and bearish sentiment in actual outcomes, making sentiment-based forecast adjustments ineffective",
    "Prices show clear mean reversion toward ~70-72 range which model doesn't account for, causing 3-6 unit deviations"
] }
